title: Rav Shmuel bar Shimi

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Keritot 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.27b.10) (Hyman cites 26b): he explained [a teaching] before Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Shmuel bar Shimi explaining the earlier statement before Rav Papa. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3396&lang=en) cites 27b for this occurrence. Hyman gives 26b.
